en: Revenue rose 45% to a record $13.4B, above the $13.1B consensus, and non-GAAP EPS of $2.09 beat $1.95. Data center nearly doubled (+97%) to $8.5B, 64% of sales, as the first MI450-based Helios racks reached OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Microsoft and Oracle. The Q4 guide of about $17B (+66%) topped the ~$16.2B expected, though gross margin dips to about 55%. CEO Lisa Su said growth accelerates as Helios and Venice production scales, and told analysts 2027 revenue could grow more than 80%.

AMD rose 3.7% to $483.90 into the report and jumped up to 8% after hours, but the first session closed up just 1.0% at $488.78 as midterm worries hit chips. On Nov 5 it sank 17.3% to $404.40 as the chip index fell 12% on AI-regulation fears. It then rebounded: an Oppenheimer upgrade and Google's choice of EPYC as TPU host CPU lifted it 13.3% on Nov 9, and CoreWeave's results, a Goldman top-pick call and a $2.5B Anthropic IPO stake added 7.3% on Nov 11 to $552.90, 14.3% above the pre-report close.
zh: 营收增长 45% 至创纪录的 134 亿美元，高于 131 亿美元的市场预期；非 GAAP 每股收益 2.09 美元，高于 1.95 美元。数据中心营收近乎翻倍（+97%）至 85 亿美元，占总营收 64%，首批搭载 MI450 的 Helios 机柜已交付 OpenAI、Meta、Anthropic、微软和甲骨文。第四季营收指引约 170 亿美元（+66%），高于约 162 亿美元的预期，但毛利率将降至约 55%。CEO 苏姿丰表示，随着 Helios 与 Venice 量产扩大，增长将进一步加速，并向分析师表示 2027 年营收增幅可能超过 80%。

财报前股价上涨 3.7% 至 483.90 美元，盘后一度大涨 8%，但首个交易日因中期选举担忧拖累芯片股，仅收涨 1.0% 至 488.78 美元。11 月 5 日，费城半导体指数因 AI 监管担忧大跌 12%，AMD 重挫 17.3% 至 404.40 美元。随后股价反弹：奥本海默上调评级、谷歌选用 EPYC 作为 TPU 主机处理器，推动 11 月 9 日大涨 13.3%；CoreWeave 业绩亮眼、高盛将其列为首选芯片股、以及 Anthropic IPO 中 25 亿美元的认购，使 11 月 11 日再涨 7.3% 至 552.90 美元，较财报前收盘高 14.3%。

bio.en: MIT-trained engineer who spent years at IBM and Freescale before joining AMD in 2012. CEO since 2014, she rebuilt AMD around Ryzen and EPYC processors and is now pushing Instinct AI accelerators against NVIDIA.
bio.zh: 毕业于麻省理工的工程师，曾在 IBM 和飞思卡尔任职多年，2012 年加入 AMD。2014 年起任 CEO，以 Ryzen 和 EPYC 处理器重振 AMD，目前以 Instinct AI 加速器挑战英伟达。

bio.en: CFO since 2022. Previously CFO of Marvell for six years and before that of QLogic and Conexant; holds a PhD in economics.
bio.zh: 2022 年起任 CFO。此前任 Marvell CFO 六年，更早担任 QLogic 和 Conexant 的 CFO；拥有经济学博士学位。
